chapters.title: Round letters
chapters.goal: Start with an open curve, close it, then reuse the shape in a and d.

chapters.title: Tall and finishing strokes
chapters.goal: Practice a tall downstroke, then work on the crossbar and dot.

chapters.title: Tails below the line
chapters.goal: Carry the stroke below the baseline and finish it cleanly.

chapters.title: Bridges and humps
chapters.goal: Go back up the stroke and over the top in one smooth movement.

chapters.title: More curves
chapters.goal: Control loops and S-curves, and keep the bottoms round.

chapters.title: Diagonals
chapters.goal: Keep slanted lines straight and meeting at sharp points.

chapters.title: Checkpoint
chapters.goal: Write from memory, including a letter that needs another look.
